newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Chidambaram, RBI start post-budget meeting.
newsitem.headline: India's Chidambaram, RBI start post-budget meeting.

text.p: Indian Finance Minister P. Chidambaram and Reserve Bank of India (RBI) governor C. Rangarajan began the traditional post-budget meeting in the Indian capital on Monday, RBI officials said.
Neither Chidambaram nor Rangarajan spoke to the press upon entering the RBI building in New Delhi.
An RBI official said the meeting, which began shortly after 10 a.m. (0430 GMT), was expected to last until about 1 p.m. (0730 GMT).
The RBI said it expected to issue a statement summarising the meeting after 3 p.m. (0930 GMT).

Chidambaram told Reuters in an interview on Saturday that he would discuss the RBI's new credit policy, set to be announced in the second week of April, with the central bank officials at Monday's meeting.
The finance minister said they also would discuss the need to maintain price stability, a surge in foreign exchange inflows and bank credit.
Chidambaram presented the government's 1997/98 (April-March) budget to parliament in February. Lawmakers are expected to vote on the plan in late April.
